text: Good evening, sorry to bother you so late, I'm not sure if I'm being a silly old woman. I've got my grandson tonight, he's 2, and his temperture is 39.3. He's got a runny snotty nose and keeps sneezing, poor lamb, all over me mostly. He was sick once about 7 oclock but since then he's had his milk and some water and kept it all down no bother. Now the bit that frightend me. His cheeks went very red this afternoon and I panicked thinking it was a rash, but we'd been at the park and the wind was bitter, it was blowing right in his face for an hour. I did the glass thing my daughter told me about and it went pale straight away, and there's no other spots anywhere on him, I checked his whole body in the bath. His colour is normal and his lips are nice and pink like always. I just don't know if 39.3 needs seeing tonight or if I give him calpol and keep an eye. My daughter is away till tomorrow and I don't want to do the wrong thing with him.
